description: This file defines API endpoints for managing vector stores, including creation, listing, deletion, retrieval, and updating. It also contains internal logic for resolving embedding configurations from a database.

classes.name: LiteLLM_ManagedVectorStore
classes.description: Data model representing a managed vector store.

classes.name: LiteLLM_ManagedVectorStoreListResponse
classes.description: Response model for listing vector stores.

classes.name: VectorStoreDeleteRequest
classes.description: Request model for deleting a vector store.

classes.name: VectorStoreInfoRequest
classes.description: Request model for retrieving vector store info.

classes.name: VectorStoreUpdateRequest
classes.description: Request model for updating a vector store.

classes.name: ResponseLiteLLM_ManagedVectorStore
classes.description: Response model for a single vector store's details.

methods.name: _resolve_embedding_config_from_db
methods.description: Resolves embedding configuration from the database based on the model name, decrypting stored parameters.

methods.name: new_vector_store
methods.description: Creates a new vector store, resolving embedding configs if needed, and adds it to registry.

methods.name: list_vector_stores
methods.description: Lists all vector stores, combining in-memory and database entries with pagination.

methods.name: delete_vector_store
methods.description: Deletes a specified vector store from database and registry.

methods.name: get_vector_store_info
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific vector store.

methods.name: update_vector_store
methods.description: Updates details of an existing vector store.
